lastCompletedStory.title: Idempotent migration script for the live issues.local.json

nextStoryContext: US-005 is complete. scripts/cam/migrate-issues-schema.ts exports migrateBacklog(raw: unknown): IssuesLocalJson. The pure transform maps old schema entries (state:open->stage:idea; state:closed/done/canceled->stage:shipped; derives status; drops priority/closedAt/state; sets blockedBy:[]). Idempotency guard: entries with stage and no state/priority are passed through unchanged. CLI entrypoint uses Bun.file (gated by import.meta.main). 22 tests pass in test/issues/migrate.test.ts. The actual run on the real issues.local.json is US-008 (operator story). Check what the next story is and proceed accordingly.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal transform: uses IssueEntry/IssuesLocalJson from src/issues/types.ts and Bun built-ins (Bun.file, Bun.write). No external library API exercised.
